[Story]
Zhang Tingting is a music lover, she learns that her neighbor Mr. Zhao is about to hold a piano concert at the community center.

[Question]
Zhang Tingting should be excited about Mr. Zhao's piano concert, but she feels sad, why?

[Candidate Answers]
A. Zhang Tingting unexpectedly learns that the concert is Mr. Zhao's commemoration of his deceased wife.
B. Zhang Tingting finds out that the concert ticket price is high, she can't afford it, so she feels sad.
C. Zhang Tingting is sick, she can't attend the concert, this makes her feel sad.
D. Zhang Tingting finds out that Mr. Zhao invites people she doesn't like to the concert.
